title: UI wave 2 U7: Sliding selection in Segmented and the sidebar; the new selected look (E part 2, J)
description: Plan task U7. Follow docs/agent-work/2026-10-26-ui-wave-2/PLAN.md exactly: this task's section (Files, Interfaces, Steps, Acceptance check, Fail-first, Stop-and-ask, Default) plus the seven answered Open questions and the Notes for the implementer. Protocol: register the serial check slot via files add only right before the first expensive check and keep it until done; pinned Node; quoted --outDir; no installs, no commits; status CLAIMED; independent review required.

review.note: APPROVED by agent-0f57 (Sonnet reviewer). Diff read: Segmented.tsx/segmented.css (.segmented-highlight first child, container relative, buttons transparent z1, pressed fill rule deleted), ProjectSidebar.tsx (one .sidebar-highlight first child of .sidebar-groups and .sidebar-bottom-groups, both relative; target = first non-cards .entry-row.selected else .group-title.selected; slideHighlight from src/motion.ts, no new motion code; ResizeObserver places instantly), styles.css selected look (Plain --text + 600 via .sidebar .selected; Plain-only :active override beats generic .sidebar .group-title:active accent; Color :active entry rule uses --tint), AGENTS.md sentence per plan, no docs/design-system.md edit (DESIGN DOC text is in the note), layout.spec.ts unchanged as planned. Fail-first logs real (ui2-u7/failfirst-*.log: 5 expected failures, 2 strengthened motion failures, active-colour failure on pre-U7 dist). Assertions only changed where U7 requires (blue -> rgb(36,36,40)); the sections:{...} edits in appearance.spec/palette.test belong to U10 not U7. FRESH RUN (my own build ui2-u7-review/dist, port 1598): vitest palette/designTokens/motion 38/38; tsc exit 0; Playwright appearance+layout+sidebar-selection+motion-u7 = 29/29 (3.0m), incl. 190px no-wrap and both transform/opacity motion cases. My extra probe (12 sections, 520px viewport, sidebar scrolled 80px): highlight within 1px of selected row when scrolled, after keyboard Enter selection, and bottom highlight on Settings; Plain light/dark selected colour rgb(36,36,40)/rgb(237,237,240) weight 600; Color light/dark rgb(0,98,205)/rgb(65,160,255); reduced motion = 0 animations. Native smoke rebuild exit 0, native-screens plain and color both exit 0 (10 PNGs each). VIEWED: browser writing Plain Light/Dark, Color Light, Settings Plain Light, Settings Color Dark, author's plain-light and color-dark; native Plain writing-light, native Plain settings-dark, native Color research-dark: selected entry semibold on 6% fill, no blue in Plain sidebar, orange/blue tints in Color. NON-BLOCKING NOTES for later tasks: (1) the Settings bottom row highlight is a tight 57px chip around the label (group-title button is content width) while entries get full-row fill; U9 (fixed bottom rows) could make the bottom rows full width. (2) Plain still shows accent blue momentarily while pressing an UNSELECTED sidebar row (.sidebar .group-title:active / .entry-main:active, pre-existing, not selected). (3) Color :active on a selected group-title uses accent not its tint (rare). (4) A previously selected entry keeps its fill/semibold while Settings/Research is the destination (pre-existing semantics). LIMIT: Chromium preview plus native WebKit screenshots only; no owner real-use proof.
